decision_rationale: The record describes using and fine-tuning existing foundation models (DNABERT, DNABERT-2, Nucleotide Transformer) for downstream lncRNA analysis, not proposing a new generative model. It gives explicit foundation-model background and pretraining details, but no generative architecture for the candidate paper.
evidence_snippet: "We included 3 well-established foundation models pre-trained on large unlabeled human genome data"; "conducted a comprehensive exploration by finetuning these models on a series of downstream task"
